cards.card_text: Peter says these false teachers will bring in destructive heresies.
cards.verse_text: They will secretly introduce destructive heresies, even denying the Master who bought them—bringing swift destruction on themselves.
cards.snippet: They will secretly introduce destructive heresies, even denying the Master who bought them—bringing swift destruction on themselves.

cards.card_text: Peter says the false teachers will bring in their heresies out in the open where everyone can see them coming.
